Class RedScoringPaths

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.pedro.auto.RedScoringPaths
public final class RedScoringPaths extends Object
Navigation waypoints for the Red Scoring autonomous.

IMPORTANT: The strategy image has no coordinate/heading labels. The poses below are estimates from the 144-inch field grid, not measured instructions. Verify them against the field and robot orientation BEFORE enabling motion. The diagonal parking segment has not been collision-clearance certified.
